metaDescription: Bibi Russell, the queen of Bangladeshi fashion design, deserves all the flowers. Why B-POP Tags honours the innovators who paved the way for pop culture.

summaryBn: বাঙালি পপ কালচার একদিনে তৈরি হয়নি; উদ্ভাবকেরাই উন্নয়ন ও বৈশ্বিক স্বীকৃতির পথ তৈরি করেছেন। সেই উদ্ভাবকদের একজন, ফ্যাশন ডিজাইন জগতের রানি বিবি রাসেলকে তাঁর কাজ ও নিষ্ঠার জন্য শ্রদ্ধা জানিয়েছে বি-পপ ট্যাগস।
lede: Bengali pop culture wasn't built in a day. B-POP Tags honours Bibi Russell, the queen of the country's fashion design industry.
body:
Bengali pop culture "wasn't built in a day". B-POP Tags opened its tribute to **Bibi Russell** with that reminder: innovators came first and "paved the path for development and global recognition".

## Bibi Russell, queen of Bangladeshi fashion design

The post calls [@bibi_russell_official](https://www.instagram.com/bibi_russell_official/) "the queen of our fashion designing industry" and says she "deserves all the flowers for her work and dedication". It also tags two related accounts, [@bibirussellshop](https://www.instagram.com/bibirussellshop/) and [@bibirussell_dhaniakhali](https://www.instagram.com/bibirussell_dhaniakhali/), for anyone who wants to explore further.

## A tribute in pink and blue

The cover is bold and simple: her name in huge hot-pink capitals on black, above two blue-tinted portraits. The hashtags, #bibirussell, #fashiondesigners, #bangladeshidesigner and #popculturebd, place her where B-POP believes she belongs, at the root of the culture.

## Why we look back

Celebrating the people who laid the foundations is part of how we cover today's scene in [Art & Fashion](topic:art). Read how [Samaha Subah helps Bangladeshi heritage set international trends](post:samaha-subah-nakshi-kantha-art), see where fashion is heading with [cybersigilism](post:cybersigilism-bangladeshi-fashion), and meet another pioneer in [Jamil's Comics and Bangladesh's comic book culture](post:jamils-comics-bangladesh-comic-book-culture). More on the [B-POP Tags home page](home:).

[See the original post on Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/p/DcWp1-rEpP2/)
